dateActivities.name: Lie on the grass, watch the clouds

greet.stranger.text: Oh, hello! I don't think we've met. I'm {name}.
Hi there! You're new around here, aren't you? I'm {name}.
Oh! Sorry, you startled me. I'm {name}... hi.
Hi! I'm {name}! I know basically everyone here, so you're my new project.
Hi. {name}. I'd say I come here often, but you'd only use it against me.

greet.stranger.impressed.text: Hi! Sorry, I have to say it: I love your {item}. I'm {name}.
H-hi. I'm {name}. Your {item} is... really nice.
Okay, first: where did you get that {item}? Second: I'm {name}!
{name}. That {item} is a good choice, by the way. Rare round here.

greet.acquaintance.text: Hi again, {player}. I was hoping... never mind. Hi.
Hey, {player}! Twice in one week, people are going to talk!
You again. I'm starting to think you're following me, {player}.

greet.friend.text: {player}! I was hoping I'd see you today.
There's my favourite person to bump into. Hi, {player}!
{player}! Okay, sit, I have so much to tell you.
Oh good, someone worth talking to.
{player}. You've improved my day by a measurable amount.

greet.close.text: There you are. Come sit with me?
Hi... I always feel calmer when you're around, {player}.
My favourite human! Get over here!
I was getting bored without you. Don't let it go to your head.

greet.dating.text: I... was thinking about you just now.
{player}! I was literally just about to message you!
There you are. I was about to file a missing person report.

greet.remember.date.text: I keep thinking about our date at {location}. Can we do that again soon?
I had a really nice time at {location}... just so you know.
{location} was SO fun! I told everyone. Well, almost everyone.
{location} was good. Better than good. Don't make me say it twice.

greet.remember.gift.text: Hey, {player}! I've been enjoying {gift} you gave me. Thank you again.
I put {gift} somewhere I can see it every day.
Guess who's been showing off {gift} to literally everyone? Me!
{gift}. Still using it. You have good instincts.

greet.remember.topic.text: Hi, {player}! I've been thinking about what we said about {topic}.
I can't stop thinking about our chat about {topic}. You made my day.
I... read up on {topic} after we talked. Is that weird?
{player}! More {topic} talk today? Please say yes.
I've had better conversations about {topic}. Kidding. That was the best one.

greet.gossip.text: {friend} won't stop saying nice things about you, you know.
{friend} says you're amazing, and {friend} is never wrong!

greet.news.together.text: Did you hear? {a} and {b} are together now!
Um, so... {a} and {b} are a couple. Isn't that sweet?
Big news! {a} and {b}! Together! I called it!
{a} and {b} finally worked it out. About time.

greet.news.apart.text: Have you heard? {a} and {b} split up.
{a} and {b} broke up... I feel bad for them.
{a} and {b} called it quits. Saw that coming.

greet.news.mine.together.text: I have news: I'm seeing {other} now!
Can I tell you something? {other} and I are... together.
{other} and I are a thing now. Try to act surprised.

greet.news.mine.apart.text: {other} and I broke up. I'm... okay. Mostly.
{other} and I aren't together any more...
{other} and I are done. It's fine. It's fine.

greet.jealous.text: So I hear you've been seeing {friend} too.
{friend} told me about you two... I thought we had something.
{friend}, really? You could have told me yourself.

invite.text: I'll be at {location} around {time}. Come find me?
Are you free later? I'll be at {location} from {time}. It'd be lovely to see you.
Um, I'll be at {location} at {time}... if you wanted to come. No pressure.

invite.met.text: You came! I was hoping you would.
Yay, you made it! Okay, I have plans for us.

ask.likes.text: Um... I like {topic}. A lot, actually.
{topic}! Don't get me started. Okay, get me started.

ask.dislikes.text: I'll tell you what I can't stand: {topic}.
Whatever you do, don't bring up {topic}.

ask.nothing.text: You already know all my secrets!
You've heard it all by now.

ask.plans.none.text: Nothing much. Probably home after this.

ask.friends.text: I'm close with {friend}. You should meet them!
{friend} is my best friend. They're lovely.
{friend} puts up with me. That counts.

ask.friends.partner.text: I'm seeing {partner}, actually. It's going well.
I'm... with {partner}. Did you not know?
{partner} and I are together. In case you were wondering.

ask.friends.none.text: I keep to myself, mostly. Maybe that'll change.
I don't really have many friends here yet...

ask.nosy.text: That's a bit personal. We've only just met.

ask.again.text: You asked me that already today!
Same answer as an hour ago.

bark.rain.text: Ugh, this rain. Glad to be inside.

bark.rain.out.text: I'm only out here because I'm stubborn.

bark.work.text: I love it here. Mostly. Some days.
Three more hours. Not that I'm counting.

bark.night.text: Who's up for staying out late?
I said I'd be home by ten. Ha.

bark.interest.text: I could really go for some {topic} right now.
I wonder if anyone here likes {topic}...
Has anyone seen anything good about {topic} lately?

greet.stranger.family.text: Wait, are you the one my {relation} {sibling} keeps talking about? Hi!
Oh! You know {sibling}... my {relation}. {sibling} says you're really nice.
It's you! My {relation} {sibling} will not stop talking about you!
So you're the famous friend. My {relation} {sibling} wasn't exaggerating.

greet.makeover.haircut.text: Hey! Notice anything? I got my hair cut.
Hi... I got a haircut. Is it weird?
New hair! New me! Do you love it? Be honest. Love it.
Yes, I got a haircut. Yes, on purpose.

greet.makeover.colour.text: Hi! So... I dyed my hair. What do you think?
Oh, hi. I tried a new hair colour. I'm still getting used to it.
Look, look! New colour! I couldn't resist!
Before you say anything: it's called a change.

greet.makeover.clothes.text: Hi! I finally treated myself to some new clothes.
Hi. I, um, bought some new things. Do they look okay?
Shopping spree! Everything's new! Well, nearly everything!
New clothes. I'm told it's a thing people do.

compliment.makeover.haircut.text: You like it? I was so nervous about it!
Really? ...Thank you. I was worried it was too much.
You noticed! Okay, you're officially my favourite person.

compliment.makeover.colour.text: Thank you! I wasn't sure it suited me.
You think so? That's... that makes me really happy.
Right?! I feel like a whole new person!
Good. I was this close to dyeing it back.

compliment.makeover.clothes.text: Thank you thank you! I knew they were the right ones!

bark.makeover.haircut.text: Still not used to this haircut.

bark.makeover.colour.text: I keep catching my reflection. New colour!
Is everyone looking at my hair?
I love this colour so much!

bark.makeover.clothes.text: First day in the new clothes.
New outfit day is the best day!
The new clothes are growing on me.

greet.player.makeover.love.text: Wait, your hair! Oh, I love it. It really suits you.
Oh! Your hair... it looks really, really good.
Stop it! Your hair! It's perfect! Who did it?
New hair. Good call. Very good call.

greet.player.makeover.nice.text: Oh, you changed your hair! Nice.
You got a new haircut? It's nice.

greet.player.makeover.meh.text: Oh! You changed your hair. It's... different.
Your hair's different. I'll get used to it, I'm sure.
New hair! That's... a choice! A bold one!
Hm. Your old hair was fine, you know.

greet.cheated.text: So. I heard you went out with {other}.
I... heard about you and {other}. Was I not enough?
Funny story! Everyone's saying you went on a date with {other}. Funny, right?

greet.breakup.text: I heard about {other}. I think we're done.
I can't keep doing this. I'm sorry. It's over.
I'm done pretending this is fine. We're over.
We're finished. Say hi to {other} for me.

chat.open.interest.text: Can I tell you about {topic}? I've been thinking about it all week.
I, um... have you ever gotten really into {topic}? Because I have.
Okay, okay, I have to talk about {topic} with someone or I'll burst!
Hot take incoming about {topic}. Brace yourself.

chat.open.day.text: Long day. Work was a lot.
Today was... kind of a lot.
You would not believe the day I've had!
Today happened. Every minute of it.

chat.open.worry.text: Can I tell you something? I've been a bit stressed lately.
Sorry, I'm a bit quiet today. I've got a lot on my mind.
I'm fine! Mostly. Okay, not totally fine.
Don't panic, but I'm worried about something.

chat.open.dream.text: If you could live anywhere at all, where would it be?
Do you ever daydream about just... leaving? Going somewhere new?
Quick, pick a dream holiday! I'll go first: everywhere!
Somewhere far away. That's my whole plan.

chat.more.interest.text: Honestly, {topic} is the thing that keeps me sane.
I don't usually tell people how much I love {topic}. It's nice to.
Okay, so here's the thing about {topic}: once you start, you can't stop!
Fine. {topic} might be the best thing in my life. Don't spread it around.

chat.more.day.text: Honestly, I think I just needed someone to talk to.
Sorry for going on. You're easy to talk to.
Ugh, okay, I feel better already. You're good for me!
Anyway. That's more than I tell most people.

chat.more.worry.text: It's just... I keep thinking I'm not good enough at what I do.
I keep worrying everyone's disappointed in me. Silly, right?
I put on a brave face, but sometimes I feel like I'm faking all of it.
I suspect I'm bad at my job. And my life. Mostly my job.

chat.more.dream.text: Somewhere by the sea, maybe. Somewhere I could start over.
A little house somewhere quiet. With a garden. Is that boring?
Tokyo, then Lisbon, then a beach with nobody on it. Then home, maybe.
A cabin. No neighbours. Excellent coffee.

chat.more.interest.warm.text: You're sweet. Honestly, {topic} is the thing that keeps me sane.
That's... really nice of you to say. I don't usually get to talk about {topic}.
You're the best! Okay, so {topic} is basically my whole personality.
Flattery works. Fine: {topic} might be the best thing in my life.

chat.more.interest.playful.text: Excuse me, it's even cooler. Let me prove it to you sometime.
It is! Well. I think so. Maybe I could show you?
Cooler! Way cooler! I'll take you, you'll see!
Is it? Bold of you. I'll make you eat those words.

chat.more.interest.curious.text: It started when I was a kid, and I just never stopped.
Oh, um. A friend showed me once, and I got hooked.
Okay, story time! It all started with a very bad afternoon...
Long story. Short version: boredom, then obsession.

chat.more.day.warm.text: Yeah. I'd like that. You're easy to be around.
...Okay. Thanks. I think I needed that.

chat.more.day.playful.text: Ha! Not even a little. Everyone bosses me around.
Ha... no. Nobody listens to me.
I wish! I'd make everyone take a dance break.

chat.more.day.curious.text: Everything at once, you know? I think I just needed someone to listen.
Just... lots of little things. Thanks for asking, though.
Where do I start? Okay. So. First, the coffee machine...
Meetings. Then more meetings. Then I came here.

chat.more.worry.warm.text: Thank you. It's just... I keep thinking I'm not good enough at what I do.
Thank you. I keep worrying everyone's disappointed in me.
Okay. Okay. I put on a brave face, but sometimes I feel like I'm faking it.
...Fine. I suspect I'm bad at my job. There, I said it.

chat.more.worry.playful.text: Ha. Okay, that helped a little. It's work stuff. It's always work stuff.
That's... actually kind of funny. Thanks.
Ha! Okay, you got me. It's work. It's always work.

chat.more.worry.curious.text: Maybe. It's work. I keep thinking I'm not good enough at it.
I don't know. I just feel like I'm letting people down.
Can you fix being terrible at everything? Kidding. Mostly.
Unless you can do my job for me, probably not. But thanks.

chat.more.dream.warm.text: You think so? Somewhere by the sea, maybe. Somewhere I could start over.
Really? I've always wanted a little house somewhere quiet.
Aww! Okay, it's a beach. With nobody on it. And a hammock!
It would. A cabin, no neighbours, excellent coffee.

chat.more.dream.playful.text: Free snacks are non-negotiable, obviously. And somewhere by the sea.
Ha, and a garden. A quiet garden. With snacks.
Snacks AND a beach! You get me!

chat.more.dream.curious.text: I think I want somewhere nobody knows me. A fresh start.
Quiet, mostly. Somewhere I can just be myself.
The sea! I've never even seen it properly, can you believe it?
Silence. I'd pay good money for silence.

chat.close.heard.text: I really like talking to you, you know.
I feel like you actually listen. Thank you.
Best chat I've had all week. Maybe all month!
You're alright. Don't let it go to your head.

chat.react.good.text: You always know what to say.

chat.react.bad.text: That's... not really what I meant.

talk.love.text: Oh, I could talk about {topic} all day!
You like {topic} too? We're going to get along just fine.
You like {topic} too? That's... really nice.
{topic}?! Okay, you've unlocked the talkative version of me.
You always know just what to bring up. {topic} with you is the best.

talk.neutral.text: I don't know much about {topic}, but I like hearing you talk about it.
{topic}... I don't really know much about it. Sorry.

talk.dislike.text: Oh... {topic}? Maybe we could talk about something else?

talk.bored.text: We already covered {topic} today, didn't we?
{topic} again? You're sweet, but come on.
If you mention {topic} once more I'm charging admission.

compliment.pleased.text: That's so sweet of you to say.
Stop it! No, wait, keep going.
You always know how to make me smile.

compliment.style.text: Thank you! And honestly, your {item} is great too.
Th-thanks... I like your {item}, by the way.
Thanks! Matching compliments: your {item} is amazing!

compliment.awkward.text: That's kind, but... we only just met.
Laying it on a bit thick, aren't we?

gift.love.text: You remembered I'd like this... thank you.

gift.ok.text: Oh... thank you. That's nice of you.

gift.dislike.text: I'll find somewhere to put {gift}, I suppose.

gift.again.text: Another one? You really don't have to...
Two in one day. Should I be worried?

gift.awkward.text: A present? We've only just met...
For me? But you barely know me...
Bit soon for presents, isn't it?

date.yes.text: A date at {location}? I'd love that.
Y-yes. I'd like that a lot.
Yes! Yes yes yes! {location}, here we come!
Fine. It's a date. Don't be late.

date.taken.text: {partner} might have something to say about that.

date.leaves.text: I can't keep pretending. I'll talk to {partner}... Yes. Let's go.
I've felt this for a while. I'll tell {partner}. Yes.
I'm going to regret telling {partner}. But yes.

date.no.text: That's sweet, but I don't think I feel that way.
I really like you, {player}, just... not like that. Not yet, anyway.
I... I'm sorry. I'm not ready for that.

date.notyet.text: Maybe once we know each other a bit better?
Ooh, slow down, we've barely started!
Ask me again after you've bought me a coffee. Or five.

date.talk.love.text: I could talk about {topic} with you all night.
Talking about {topic} with you is... really nice.
Okay, this date just got ten times better. {topic}!

date.talk.neutral.text: I don't know much about {topic}, but I like listening to you.

date.talk.dislike.text: Oh... {topic}. Could we talk about something else?

date.awkward.text: Well... that was a date. Thanks, I guess.
Sorry, I think I was just nervous...

date.activity.love.text: This is perfect. I'm having so much fun!
I really... love this. Thank you for suggesting it.
Fine, I admit it. This is great.

date.activity.dislike.text: Not really my thing, but okay.
I'm not very good at this...

date.partner.text: I don't want to see anyone else. Just you. Is that... okay?
Today made something clear: I want us to be together. Properly.
Can I say something? I... I'd like to be yours. Only yours.
Okay, I'm saying it: be my partner! Officially! Please?
Let's stop pretending this is casual. You're it for me.

date.great.text: Thank you for today. I didn't want it to end.
I had... the best time. Really.
Best. Date. Ever. I'm calling it.
That was... actually perfect. Don't tell anyone I said that.

date.fine.text: That was nice. Thanks for today.
That was lovely. Maybe somewhere else next time?
Thank you for taking me. It was nice.
Not bad. I'd do it again.
